scope_label: customer-to-technical grid in a House of Quality
definition: In a House of Quality, the relationship matrix is the grid that pairs customer requirements with proposed technical characteristics and provides a cell for each assessed link.
explanation: The rows represent customer-side needs and the columns represent design-side responses. A mark or score expresses an assessed relationship under a stated convention; different methods may use different scales.
The grid helps a team consider which responses address which needs. Its entries are planning judgments and should not be mistaken for measurements of the finished product or service.
